title: First double sashay
summary: In Black Swan: Why It Gotta Be Black? (US-S05-E04), Honey Mahogany and Vivienne Pinay lip-synced to Britney Spears' "Oops!... I Did It Again." RuPaul eliminated both — the first double sashay in Drag Race history.

title: Alyssa vs Roxxxy: Whip My Hair
summary: In the RuPaul Roast (US-S05-E07), Alyssa Edwards and Roxxxy Andrews lip-synced to Willow Smith's "Whip My Hair." Both won a double shantay after an iconic lip-sync; no one was eliminated.

title: Jinkx Monsoon wins Season 5
summary: After a deferred crowning lip-sync to "The Beginning" in The Final Three, Hunty (US-S05-E12), Jinkx Monsoon was crowned at the live reunion (US-S05-E14). Alaska and Roxxxy Andrews were runners-up. The cash prize was $100,000.

title: Ivy Winters Miss Congeniality
summary: Ivy Winters was voted Miss Congeniality by viewers, announced at the Season 5 reunion (US-S05-E14).
